SmartCopy_will_no_longer_do_geo_location.message: SmartCopy will no longer automatically do geo-location lookups due to the cost of Google's service. While this is sad news, Geni has recently provided the feature of doing geolocation lookups after submission. When a location is submitted via the place field, Geni will do the query and populate the location fields on the website. Alternatively, you can specify your own Google API key in the configuration. You also still have the option to manually fill out the location data in SmartCopy by clicking the globe icon $globe_icon$ and if you want to disable Geni's geolocation lookup, you can do so in the SmartCopy configuration.
